claim_boundary: This is a one-backbone development sufficiency test. It does not confirm population-level v2, identify a biological controller, prove that the gate estimates an offline crossing, change tanh, introduce a new memory channel, or permit end-to-end co-adaptation. A valid failure closes the scalar amplitude-gating family rather than shrinking the supported fast-weight global-assembly claim.

crossing_alignment_diagnostic_only.orientation_reduction: mean conditioned gamma over the two direct orientations

registered_rules.H_greater_A_rescue: The paired retained-subject bootstrap lower bound for opposition minus original H>A direct correctness exceeds zero, and H>A under opposition is not robustly wrong-sign: its bootstrap upper bound is at least zero.
registered_rules.control_specificity: Each paired participant-bootstrap lower bound for opposition minus matched-global, opposition minus shuffled-opposition, and opposition minus sign-reversed-support retained-relation mean direct correctness exceeds zero.
registered_rules.crossing_correlation_not_a_gate: Spearman(gamma, offline crossing midpoint) is reported as a mechanistic diagnostic but cannot pass or fail the candidate.
registered_rules.fast_weight_necessity: The opposition condition passes every qualification_v2 intervention and order-invariance rule.
registered_rules.global_reassembly_preservation: Opposition remote absolute and third-party relational estimands each have bootstrap lower bounds above zero and point estimates at least 80 percent of original v1.
registered_rules.local_rescue: The paired participant-bootstrap lower bound for opposition minus original retained-relation mean direct correctness exceeds zero.
registered_rules.nonlearned_preservation: Opposition nonlearned accuracy is at least 0.70 and no more than 0.02 below original v1.
registered_rules.preserve_other_relations: The opposition-minus-original mean over the other seven retained relations has a paired-bootstrap lower bound no smaller than -0.01.
registered_rules.query_binding_preservation: Both opposition matched-minus-mismatch normalized operator-gain contrasts remain positive and equal original within 1e-7 because the estimand is pre-gate.
registered_rules.terminal_projection_preservation: The opposition expected-rank-minus-MAP participant-bootstrap lower bound exceeds zero.
